warning_signs.title: Warning Signs
warning_signs.subtitle: Knowledge that reassures and protects
warning_signs.emergency_call: In case of urgent concern, immediately contact your maternity clinic or local emergency medical services.
warning_signs.pregnancy_signs_title: During Pregnancy — Seek medical care if you notice:
warning_signs.pregnancy_sign1: Vaginal bleeding of any degree or leaking amniotic fluid.
warning_signs.pregnancy_sign2: Severe and persistent headache, or visual disturbances (flashing spots).
warning_signs.pregnancy_sign3: Sudden swelling of face and hands.
warning_signs.pregnancy_sign4: Fever above 37.8°C (100°F) or acute abdominal pain.
warning_signs.pregnancy_sign5: Noticeable decrease in baby movements (after 24 weeks).
warning_signs.baby_signs_title: In the Newborn — Seek immediate medical assessment if you notice:
warning_signs.baby_sign2: Difficulty breathing: rapid breathing, nostrils flaring, chest caving under ribs.
warning_signs.baby_sign3: Persistent refusal to nurse or forceful projectile vomiting.
warning_signs.baby_sign4: Deep yellowish skin or eyes (severe jaundice spreading to legs).
warning_signs.baby_sign5: Extreme lethargy, floppiness, or inability to wake up for feeds.
